primary_coaching_focus.topic: Never honored the customer's explicit channel request
primary_coaching_focus.quote: Don't bother me anymore on the phone. Send me an email or send a hard copy
primary_coaching_focus.why: The customer stated a clear, specific, repeatable preference twice (01:12-01:22 and 01:39-01:54) and even confirmed Ion already has her mailing address (01:49) — removing any logistical barrier — yet the rep never once offered to send an email or hard copy, even as the closing line of the call. This is the single most consequential and most avoidable miss on the call.
